text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kitasaaan! Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're on the bus to summer camp, and
fans have
gathered all around it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so grateful that I have this many fans,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But I can't afford to let myself get
carried away!
I've gotta keep pushing
forward with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite all the praise she's been getting,
I don't
need to worry about things going
to her head.
She's been taught to be
humble since childhood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fsshhh... fsshhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the camp grounds,
Kitasan Black
falls into a contemplative
state while watching
the ocean waves.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Placing first in the popularity poll...
Placing first,
huh? Popularity sure is a
strange thing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's not related to one's strength or
achievements.
Being strong doesn't
automatically make you
popular, and
being weak doesn't necessarily
mean
you're nameless.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't think my running is up to snuff
yet,
though, if I'm aiming to be the most
popular
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Being celebrated by so many people
while
knowing I still have room to grow
makes me feel a
little weird...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Where she used to have few fans, she
now has
innumerable supporters. Kitasan
Black appears
uncertain about how to
deal with her newfound
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to help her change her
perspective so she
can get a clearer look
at things.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um... I'm not sure I get what you mean.
choice_data_list: Why not take it as 'high hopes for what's to come'?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I think I get it! Looking at it from
that angle
makes me feel better!
choice_data_list: Right, like you're about to pull off something big.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Rather than convince everyone I'm great
now, I
should make them see my future
potential
instead! That's what you
meant, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears my words of support helped
her sort
out her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But expectations are just that. It doesn't
mean
I've managed to put smiles on
anyone's faces yet.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've got to polish up my skills
this
summer, so I can live up my fans'
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So don't hold back and throw everything
you've
got at me during training! Let's
make a splash as
big as a crashing wave!
